notes: Button texts are the English MasterTextFile strings (TEXT_BUTTON_*). Screen positions are not fixed: a UI-driving agent finds each label on a screenshot before clicking.

No command-line switch loads a map directly in this build (Parse_Command_Line accepts only LOCALPORT MONITOR WINDOWED FULLSCREEN MODPATH STEAMMOD FALLBACKPATH LOGFILE RANDOMLOGFILE SYNCLOGFILTER SCREENWIDTH SCREENHEIGHT BCAST2..4 PROFILE LOWRAM FPSCAP MULTI SAFEMODE LANGUAGE DEEPSYNC MPRECORDFILE, docs/re/ghidra/strings_xrefs.csv). A quick-load-map path exists (0x68b20, 'Quick Loading Map %s...') but its trigger is not documented; if an RE pass finds it, pass it with --extra-args and the menu steps below shrink to none.
The kit starts the game WINDOWED SCREENWIDTH=1920 SCREENHEIGHT=1080 by default (easier to drive and screenshot; --fullscreen to turn off).
Graphics options are the player's own settings (stored by the game). Note their values before changing them for a capture and set them back afterwards.

scenes.title: Space skirmish at Kuat with Thrawn's Star Destroyer (Admonitor) - the main scene
answers: blue cast on the lit Thrawn SD / Colorization default
space frame order (background scene, depth-only clear, ships)
manual: Main menu > Single Player > Skirmish Battles > Space Battle.
Pick the map Kuat, play as the Empire against one AI, set Starting Credits to the maximum, then Start Game.
Select your space station and build Thrawn's Star Destroyer (Admonitor, 6200 credits, 40 s). Build a few more ships too.
Fly the Admonitor so it is lit by the sun and the planet is in the background. Zoom in so it fills about a third of the screen.
RenderDoc run: press F12 once here (Thrawn close-up), once while ships fire/explode (heat), once zoomed out (whole battle).
DXVK run: wait for a screenshot (every 15 s), toggle Shadow detail low/high in Options, wait again.
apitrace run: as soon as the Admonitor is on screen, keep it there 10 seconds, then quit the game (Esc > Quit Game). Keep the whole session short.

click 'Single Player'
click 'Skirmish Battles'
click 'Space Battle'
click the map 'Kuat' in the map list
set your faction to Empire; make sure exactly one AI opponent is present
drag the 'Starting Credits' slider to the maximum

ui_steps.expect: loading screen, then the space battle

ui_steps.do: wait ~45 s; double-click the Admonitor (or its unit button) to centre the camera; zoom in with the mouse wheel

ui_steps.expect: capture file in the run folder

ui_steps.do: send ships toward the enemy; when weapons fire / ships explode TRIGGER kuat_heat
zoom out fully; TRIGGER kuat_wide
g1.py quit (or Esc > 'Quit Game' > confirm)
ui_steps.expect: game exits; kit restores and analyses

auto_notes: auto steps: g1.py <mode> --drive K,E --probe-mod admonitor --ui-method post. Each scene's list starts from the main menu or the skirmish setup screen (the main-menu steps are skipped automatically when the setup screen is already up) and ends back on the skirmish setup screen. Kuat needs --probe-mod admonitor (Thrawn's SD at station level 1). The scenes set the player faction to Empire themselves (faction list (1354,363), then Empire (1300,419)). Scene K buys the Admonitor, waits for the build, opens Call for Reinforcements (307,950), drags the pool icon (43,221) next to the station and closes the panel; scene E buys an AT-ST company at the light factory, calls it in inside the reinforcement ring, moves it and fires Barrage Area. Coordinates were found at a client of 3652x2054 (4K minus taskbar; fit_window narrows the window to 16:9) and are scaled to any client size.
